==================
NS_STRING_ENUM on a pointer typedef
==================

typedef NSString * SDImageCoderOption NS_STRING_ENUM;

---

(translation_unit
  (type_definition
    (type_identifier)
    (pointer_declarator
      (type_identifier))))
